description: This file implements a profiler for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) within the PyTorch framework. It contains class definitions and functions for tracking GPU and CPU execution times, managing signposts for events and intervals, logging profiling statistics, and controlling GPU captures. The code interfaces with Apple's os_signpost API for performance tracing and includes mechanisms for profiling different operation types, memory copies, and fallback paths.

classes.name: BaseInfo
classes.description: Base class for profiling information, including methods for string representation.

classes.name: OperationInfo
classes.description: Represents profiling info for a specific operation, including GPU and CPU times.

classes.name: CpuFbInfo
classes.description: Contains profiling details for CPU fallback operations.

classes.name: CopyInfo
classes.description: Holds details about memory copy operations, including kind, size, and associated tensors.

classes.name: MPSProfiler
classes.description: Main class managing profiling sessions, signpost handling, statistics logging, and GPU capture for MPS within PyTorch.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts profiling info to a string for logging, includes timing details.

methods.name: buildTensorString
methods.description: Builds a string representation of a tensor, optionally including buffer ID.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current high-resolution timestamp for profiling.

methods.name: buildKernelString
methods.description: Constructs a kernel operation string based on name and tensors, including buffer IDs if specified.

methods.name: getIMPSAllocator
methods.description: Returns the current memory allocator for MPS buffers.
